overview: Reference shows a single LEGO-style minifigure Jedi holding a blue lightsaber in a two-handed pose. Plan below breaks it into 5 sub-assemblies sized for a micro/brick-built character (not a true minifig), totaling ~120 pieces.

subassemblies.name: Feet + legs (stance base)
subassemblies.description: Bottom of image: build 2 feet (left and right) and 2 legs (left and right) in a slightly staggered stance. Use 2 large foot blocks, 2 leg columns, and add 2 small knee/hip accents (1 per leg) to suggest the printed leg lines.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Bottom third of the image (white legs/feet).

subassemblies.name: Hips + torso (white tunic + brown belt)
subassemblies.description: Middle of image: build 1 hips/waist section and 1 torso block. Include 1 belt band around the waist and 1 front belt-knot/pouch detail centered. Keep torso primarily white with 2 thin dark lines to hint the robe overlap.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Center of the image (white torso with brown belt).

subassemblies.name: Arms + hands (two-handed grip)
subassemblies.description: Upper-middle: build 2 arms (left and right) bent forward, plus 2 hands (left and right) meeting at the saber hilt. Add 2 small forearm cuffs (1 per arm) to suggest sleeve edges; pose so both hands align vertically on the hilt.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Right-center of image, in front of torso (crossed/forward arms).

subassemblies.name: Head
subassemblies.description: Upper portion: build 1 head as a rounded/boxed cube. Add 2 eyes, 2 eyebrows (angled), and 1 small mouth line on the face side to match the expression.

subassemblies.name: Hair + lightsaber (hilt + blade)
subassemblies.description: Top and upper-right: build 1 hair cap with a layered/swept look, plus 1 lightsaber made of 1 hilt and 1 blade. Suggest metallic hilt bands with 2 ring details, and make the blade as a straight light-blue bar rising diagonally.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Hair at very top; lightsaber extends from hands to top-right corner.
